rules.RESULT_POLICY: Only declared output bytes/handles; each new handle labeled before visibility; no partial output accepted as success
rules.ERROR_POLICY: Report exact bounded error enum; failed/uncertain operation never successful work; unknown external effect quarantines
rules.PLATFORM_BINDING: Existing Linux symbols retained; architecture numbers/ABI layout/installed adapter FUTURE_MEASURED_OR_IMPLEMENTED; every logical predicate needs deterministic adapter proof before activation

ARGUMENT_PREDICATES.common: All scalar fields valid for operation schema; symbolic flags must belong immutable approved per-operation platform manifest; union fields unused for this operation absent. Unknown flag/command/label/operator denies. Additional no-authority-mutation invariant always conjunctive.

POINTER_POLICY.NULL: Only OPTION pointers may be absent, and only when size/count0 or operation schema explicitly no buffer. Mandatory nonempty buffer NULL denies.
POINTER_POLICY.partially_readable: DENY entire input; output buffers must be completely writable before operation
POINTER_POLICY.integer_overflow: Checked u64 add/multiply; overflow denies before memory access/allocation
POINTER_POLICY.TOCTOU: Capture complete immutable private input copy including nested bytes after bounded validation; operate solely on copy or retained object through linearized check/use; if impossible deny
POINTER_POLICY.nested_pointer: Walk exact declared vector depth2 maximum; count and sum-length bounds checked first; no cycles/selfreference/overlap of input-control and output regions; unsupported structure deny

rules.SIZE_POLICY: Declared size equals immutable validated payload length; <=max_bytes_per_operation; path<=max_path_bytes; private memory reservations<=max_private_memory
rules.COUNT_POLICY: Vector/resource count exactly array length; <=max_vector_count; sum checked u64

QUOTA_POLICY.authority: Immutable versioned HOST policy in enrolled context; no caller values/default fallback
QUOTA_POLICY.validation: Each declared value <=2^63-1; exact policy manifest hash binds context/generation. Missing/zero wherepositive/out-of-range => no activation. Numeric production values may be provisioned later, no implicit defaults.
QUOTA_POLICY.accounting: Reserve units under sole slot counter CAS before use; request+reserved overflow or >bound denies; errors release only units independently proved unconsumed; unknown outcome holds reservation and denies new work; do not reset budget by reconnect/restart.

rules.LABEL_REQUIREMENT: All resource aliases COMMITTED and exact subject/class/action policy; unknown label not usable; object transfers per logical-label-ir
rules.CREDENTIAL_REQUIREMENT: Exact purpose-specific class with current bound context/generation/registry; no SQL/private-other-slot/provider key authority
